title:
Grand Balcony Getaway
*Hot Tub*
7 min to Downtown
description:
Note: Remodel pics coming soon!!! Sleeps 12 with all rooms on one level.  Elevator and stair accessible.  Large wrap-around balcony includes fire pit and 7 person hot tub and has great views of downtown lights with additional views accessible from building rooftop.  Drone pics show full wrap-around balcony attached to this corner unit.  
Fully equipped kitchen makes for easy meals after a long day or night of exploring Nashville.  A comfy living space includes fireplace and large Smart TV.

The space
4 bedroom, 12 bed, 3 1/2 bathroom condo.  There is elevator accessibility and all rooms are on the same floor.  1700 square foot balcony includes multiple tables, Hot Tub, fire pit and outdoor games.

Guest access
Guests can use whole condo/balcony/hot tub along with the 5th floor open space.

Other things to note
Things to Do:

1. Old Town Trolley-if you haven't been to Nashville before, this is a great overview!
2. The Gulch-excellent high-end shopping
3. 12 South-up and coming high-end shopping/restaurants
4. Marathon Village-close to the condo and a cute visitor shops with several whiskey tastings available
5. Puttshack
6. Centennial Park
7. The Pedestrian Bridge
8. Belmont Mansion
9. Belle Meade Farm (Plantation)
10. Farmer's markets in several locations and on several days of the week.

Restaurants:
1. Aroi (same building as condo)--great sushi!
2. Retrograde (awesome coffee and breakfast sandwiches)
3. Taco Mama
4. Bad Ass Coffee
5. Penne Pazze
6. Assembly Hall downtown
7. Van Leeuwens Ice Cream (several locations)
8. Pancake Pantry
9. Tito's Mexican
